title: The House of Exorcism
director: Lamberto Bava, Mario Bava, Alfredo Leone
writer: Alberto Cittini, Alfredo Leone, Mario Bava
actors: Telly Savalas, Elke Sommer, Sylva Koscina
plot: A troubled priest attempts to exorcise the soul of a tourist who has been possessed by the Devil after witnessing supernatural events at a Spanish villa.
